skills.name: to-spec
skills.purpose: Turns the current conversation into a spec/PRD and publishes it to the project issue tracker (successor of the popular to-prd skill).
skills.how_to_use: Install via npx skills add mattpocock/skills; invoke after discussing a feature.
skills.evidence: mattpocock/skills 275k stars; ~320k installs (skills.sh, as to-prd/to-spec); skills.sh trending

skills.name: to-tickets
skills.purpose: Breaks a plan/spec/conversation into tracer-bullet tickets with blocking edges, published to GitHub/Linear or local files.
skills.how_to_use: Invoke after to-spec; configure the tracker per repo README.
skills.evidence: mattpocock/skills 275k stars; ~313k installs (as to-issues/to-tickets)

skills.name: bmad-prd
skills.purpose: Creates, updates or validates a PRD as part of the BMAD agile AI-driven development method (with PM agent persona).
skills.how_to_use: Install BMAD (npx bmad-method install) or copy skill; triggers on PRD work.
skills.evidence: BMAD-METHOD 53.7k stars; skills.sh hot list (bmad skills)
skills.notes: Best inside the full BMAD workflow

skills.name: prd
skills.purpose: Generates PRDs for software and AI features: executive summary, user stories, technical specs and risk analysis.
skills.how_to_use: Portable SKILL.md; triggers on "write a PRD".
skills.evidence: GitHub official awesome-copilot (39.6k stars); ~22k installs

skills.name: create-prd
skills.purpose: Writes a PRD with an 8-section template: problem, objectives, segments, value props, solution and release plan.
skills.how_to_use: Install the pm-execution plugin from phuryn/pm-skills marketplace or copy folder.
skills.evidence: phuryn/pm-skills 26.7k stars since March 2026 (65 PM skills); ~6.9k installs

skills.name: user-stories
skills.purpose: Writes user stories using the 3 Cs and INVEST, with descriptions, design links and acceptance criteria.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on backlog/user-story writing.
skills.evidence: phuryn/pm-skills 26.7k stars since March 2026 (65 PM skills); ~2.5k installs

skills.name: outcome-roadmap
skills.purpose: Rewrites output-focused roadmaps into outcome-focused ones that express user and business impact.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on roadmap rework requests.
skills.evidence: phuryn/pm-skills 26.7k stars since March 2026 (65 PM skills); ~6.5k installs

skills.name: prioritization-frameworks
skills.purpose: Reference and templates for 9 prioritisation frameworks (RICE, ICE, Kano, MoSCoW, Opportunity Score...).
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when choosing or applying a prioritisation method.
skills.evidence: phuryn/pm-skills 26.7k stars since March 2026 (65 PM skills); ~6.5k installs

skills.name: strategy-red-team
skills.purpose: Red-teams a PRD, roadmap or strategy: steelman, attack assumptions, rank failure modes and propose cheapest tests and kill criteria.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on "pressure-test this plan" requests.
skills.evidence: phuryn/pm-skills 26.7k stars since March 2026 (65 PM skills); ~5.6k installs

skills.name: pre-mortem
skills.purpose: Runs a pre-mortem on a PRD or launch plan, sorting risks into Tigers, Paper Tigers and Elephants, then into launch-blocking, fast-follow or track.
skills.how_to_use: Use before launches or PRD sign-off; give it the PRD or plan.
skills.evidence: phuryn/pm-skills 26.7k stars; skills.sh ~9.8k installs (one of the top 'prd' results)

skills.name: linear
skills.purpose: Manage Linear issues, projects and team workflows (read, create, update tickets) via the Linear MCP/API.
skills.how_to_use: Requires Linear MCP connection or API key; written for Codex, portable SKILL.md.
skills.evidence: OpenAI curated skills (27.8k stars); ~6.6k installs; Apache-2.0 in folder

skills.name: product-manager-toolkit
skills.purpose: PM toolkit: RICE prioritisation, interview analysis, PRD templates, discovery frameworks and GTM strategy, with Python helpers.
skills.how_to_use: Install the product-team plugin from alirezarezvani/claude-skills or copy folder.
skills.evidence: alirezarezvani/claude-skills 27k stars; aitmpl 1.4k downloads; skillsmp PRD query

skills.name: jira-expert
skills.purpose: Jira expert: project setup, JQL, workflows, custom fields, automation and reporting.
skills.how_to_use: Pair with the Atlassian MCP server for live Jira access.
skills.evidence: alirezarezvani/claude-skills 27k stars; skillsmp jira query top hit

skills.name: write-spec
skills.purpose: Writes a feature spec/PRD from a problem statement: goals, non-goals, success metrics, acceptance criteria, phasing.
skills.how_to_use: Install product-management plugin from anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins.

skills.name: roadmap-update

skills.how_to_use: Part of the product-management plugin; works with connected tools (Linear/Jira/Notion) when available.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic knowledge-work-plugins (26k stars); ~2.5k installs

skills.name: stakeholder-update
skills.purpose: Generates stakeholder updates tailored to audience (exec, engineering, customer) and cadence, incl. risk escalation.
skills.how_to_use: Part of the product-management plugin.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic knowledge-work-plugins (26k stars); ~2.4k installs

skills.name: sprint-planning
skills.purpose: Plans a sprint: capacity (PTO, meetings), P0 vs stretch scope, goals and carryover handling.
skills.how_to_use: Part of the product-management plugin.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic knowledge-work-plugins (26k stars); ~2.5k installs

skills.name: meeting-minutes
skills.purpose: Produces concise, actionable meeting minutes: attendees, agenda, decisions, action items with owners and due dates.
skills.how_to_use: Portable SKILL.md; paste a transcript or notes.
skills.evidence: GitHub awesome-copilot (39.6k stars); ~9.7k installs

skills.name: notion-meeting-intelligence
skills.purpose: Prepares meeting materials (agendas, pre-reads) using Notion context and research tailored to attendees.
skills.how_to_use: Requires Notion MCP connection.
skills.evidence: OpenAI curated (27.8k stars), co-authored with Notion; ~2.2k installs

skills.name: atlassian-mcp
skills.purpose: Uses the Atlassian MCP to query Jira (JQL), create/update tickets, manage sprints and edit Confluence pages (CQL).
skills.how_to_use: Requires an Atlassian MCP server connection.
skills.evidence: jeffallan/claude-skills 11.7k stars; ~3.5k installs

skills.name: prd-development
skills.purpose: Builds structured PRDs linking problem, users, solution and success criteria, with template and examples.
skills.how_to_use: Copy folder or install plugin; repo has 60+ PM skills (user stories, roadmaps, discovery).
skills.evidence: 7.1k stars; ~3.7k installs
skills.notes: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 (non-commercial share-alike) NON-COMMERCIAL license: personal/non-commercial use only.

skills.name: jobs-to-be-done
skills.purpose: Applies Jobs-to-be-Done to discovery: switching forces, hiring criteria, churn reasons and JTBD interviews.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on customer-discovery/PMF questions; repo holds many book-based PM frameworks (Inspired, Lean Startup, Mom Test).
skills.evidence: 2.3k stars; ~4.8k installs

skills.name: writing-prds
skills.purpose: Turns abstract ideas into specs aligning engineering and design on the problem and success metrics, distilled from Lennys Podcast guests.
skills.how_to_use: Copy folder or install plugin; 86 PM skills in repo.
skills.evidence: 1.4k stars (MIT); ~2.9k installs

skills.name: linear-cli
skills.purpose: Manage Linear issues from the terminal with the linear CLI (create, update, list, branch-from-issue).
skills.how_to_use: Install the linear CLI and authenticate with a Linear API key.
skills.evidence: Official skill of schpet/linear-cli (984 stars); ~7.5k installs
